description: ES modules for the swim UI, compiled by tsc (allowJs) from apps/web/static/js -> apps/web/static/dist. type:module lets `node --test` treat the .js files as ESM and makes tsc emit ESM with explicit ./x.js specifiers, matching the browser's <script type=module> loading. Migrated .ts modules run their tests on vitest (type-checked, V8 coverage); the un-migrated .js suites stay on the `node --test` pytest bridge.

scripts.qa: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run test && npm run crap
